title: Central Bank of India CBI Apprentice 2026 Online Form Live: Apply for 4500 Posts #CBIApprentice2026 #CentralBankApprentice #CBI4500Posts #BankApprentice2026 #SarkariNaukri
intro: Central Bank of India (CBI) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for the Apprentices Recruitment 2026 for 4500 Post . Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to PSPCL Jobs. Online Apply Start On June 12, 2026 & Last Date for Application is June 22, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 944/- for Male
General / OBC / EWS : Rs.708/- for Female
SC / ST : Rs. 236/- for Male / Female
Payment Mode: Pay Exam Fee through Credit Card/ Debit Card/ Net Banking Fee Mode
For Age Relaxation, Read the Notification.
Bachelor Degree in any Stream from Recognized University.
For More Details, Read the Official Notification.
Stipend/Benefits::  The apprentices are eligible for a stipend of Rs 15,000/- per month for the engagement period of one year. The apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances/benefits
Mode of Selection: Selection on the Basis of Online Exam, Local Language Test & Final Merit List.
Bachelor Degree in Any Stream from Recognized University.
4500 Apprentice Posts in Central Bank of India
One Year Training with Banking Exposure
